title: Ludwig van Beethoven - Symphony No.1 in C major Opus 21 (3)

lines.l: A bit of Beethoven, his symphony number one, the third movement.
Time for another track from my Classic FM album of the week.
It's 25 minutes past 11, if you care.
It's called Amour, and it's the new release from the violinist Esther Abrami.
Esther first saw a violin at age three,
an instrument that belonged to her late grandmother, actually,
who'd stopped playing after getting married.
And she began formal lessons around age eight or nine.
She built a massive following across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube
sight-reading tutorials, and glimpses of a musician's prep work
Well, here is a finished performance.
It's the love theme from Romeo and Juliet.
